HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION.title: Intersection of Past and Present
A strange intersection appears before you. The past and present overlap here.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION.pages.POLITE_R: You respond politely and gain valuable rewards.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION.pages.QUARREL_: You quarrel, losing some HP but removing cards.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION.pages.SEEK_HEL: You seek help and receive two potions.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME.title: False Dome
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME.pages.INITIAL.de: A false dome looms overhead, hiding the truth of the past.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME.pages.REMEMBERED: You remember the pioneer and obtain Starry Revelation.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME.pages.ANALYZED_T: You analyze the trajectory and upgrade cards.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME.pages.CHASED_FUT: You chase the future and remove all Curses.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WATER_LIKE_SHAPE.title: Shape Like Water
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WATER_LIKE_SHAPE.pages.INIT: Water flows in a shape like a living being.
Enter a hard combat. (Not yet available)
Remove a random high-rarity card and obtain Pure Water Sprite Assist.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WATER_LIKE_SHAPE.pages.TRAV: You travel together and obtain Pure Water Sprite Assist.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WATER_LIKE_SHAPE.pages.MADE: You make an excuse and obtain a relic.
